senses.gloss: *Paurāṇa, adj. (“mentioned in the Purāṇa, traditional, ancient”). I, 543 (Tripurasya nipātanaṃ), 3024 (kavayaḥ), 4685 (kathāṃ), 4721 (dharmaṃ), 8097 (do.), 8098 (rājā); [V, 2076 (mahāstrāṇāṃ); V, 3615 (gāthā), 3773 (Vasishṭhasya), 7087; VIII, 1952 (prabhāvaḥ Pārthasya Pºḥ Keśavasya ca); XII, 13525 (rūpaṃ, sc. Vishṇu's form with the horse-head); XIII, †7370 (brahmaguhāṃ); XV, 677 (vṛttiṃ).
Paurandara, adj. (“belonging to Purandara [i.e. Indra]”). § 178 (Pāṇḍu): I, 114, 4477 (gajaḥ).--§ 234 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 190, 7105 (sc. astre).
Paurāṇika, adj. (“conversant with the Purāṇa”): I, 2 (Ugraśravāḥ Sautiḥ), ††851 (do.), ††852 (= do.), 2021 (pl.), 2029 (sūtaḥ), 2119 (do.), 7777 (sūtāḥ); VI, 483 (pl.); XII, 3202 (sūtaṃ).

Paurava^1, pl. (ºāḥ) (“the descendants or Pūru,” also name of a people). § 133 (Dushyanta): I, 68, 2801 (ºāṇāṃ vaṃśakaro Dushyantaḥ).--§ 135 (Śakuntalop.): I, 73, 2968 (ºśreshṭha = Dushyanta), 2987.--§ 156 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 95, 3763 (descended from Pūru).--§ 165 (Satyavatīlābhop.): I, 100, 4008, 4009 (ruled by Śāntanu).--§ 183 (Pāṇḍu): I, 118, 4578 (ºāṇāṃ…vaṃśe jātasya, sc. Pāṇḍu).--§ 338 (Indralokābhigamanap.): III, 46, 1856 (ºvaṃśasya jananī, sc. Urvaśī).--§ 580 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 56, 2415 (followed Dhṛshṭaketu).--§ 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 111, 4266 (Saindhava-Pºāḥ, attacked Arjuna).--§ 603 (Nārāyaṇāstramokshap.): VII, 201, 9392 (only C.). Cf. Pauravaka, pl.
Paurava^2 (“descendant of Pūru” or “king of the Pauravas”) = Bṛhatkshattra^3: VII, 9330 (Bº), 9334, †9337, †9341, 9343, 9400 (B.). Cf. Paurava^7.
Paurava^3 (do.) = Śāntanu: I, 4007.
Paurava^4 (do.) = Dushyanta: I, 3047, 3105, 3107 (rāja).
Paurava^5 (do.) = Janamejaya^1: IX, 2151.
Paurava^6 (do.) = Saṃvaraṇa: I, 3735.

Paurava^7 (do.), one or more kings at the time of Yudhishṭhira. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2664 (incarnation of the Asura Śarabha).--§ 232 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 186, 6995 (Dṛḍhadhanvā?).--§ 279 (Arjuna): II, 27, 1023, 1024 (king of the Pārvatīyas?), 1025 (defeated by Arjuna).--§ 554 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 4, 77.--§ 572 (Rathātirathasaṅkhyānap.): V, 167, 5788 (a mahāratha in the army of Duryodhana).-§ 576 (Bhagavadgītāp.): VI, 17, 662 (º-Kāliṅgāḥ, in the army of Duryodhana).--§ 581 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 61, 2699 (Damanañ cāpi dāyādaṃ Pºsya).--§ 587 (do.): VI, 115, 5361 (Dhṛshṭaketu fought P.); 116, 5388, 5390, 5391, 5397, 5398, 5400 (do.).--§ 590 (Droṇābhishekap.): VII, 14, 544, 546, 547, 548, 553, 556, 558 (defeated by Abhimanyu).--§ 593 (Abhimanyuvadhap.): VII, 37, 1590 (attacked Abhimanyu).--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 5, 125 (had been slain by Arjuna in the great battle).--§ 609 (Śalyap.): IX, 2, 90 (sc. hataḥ, Jalasandhaḥ ?).--§ 611 (do.): IX, 24, 1297 (sc. hate, Jalasandhe ?). Cf. Paurava^2, Pauraveśvara.

Paurava^8, an ancient king of the Aṅgas (= Bṛhadratha^7). § 595 (Shoḍacarāj.): King P. (Aṅga, v. 2206) also had died; description of his horse-sacrifices and his gifts to brahmans versed in śikshā and akshara, whom he diverted by actors and dancers and singers; gāthās in praise of P. are sung by those who are acquainted with the history of the past (Purāṇavidaḥ) (VII, 57): VII, 57, 2196. Cf. Bṛhadratha^7, Aṅga^4.

Paurava^9, adj. (“belonging to Pūru [or to the Pauravas]”). § 144 (Yayāti): I, 75, 3170 (vayasā), 3180 (vaṃśaḥ).-§ 188 (do.): I, 85, 3500 (vayasā), 3534 (vaṃśaḥ).--§ 150 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 94, 3705 (vaṃśaṃ).
Pauravadāyāda = Vidūrathasuta: XII, 1791 (Vº).
Pauravaka, pl. (ºāḥ), a people = Paurava, pl. § 578 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 50, 2081 (in the army of Yudhishṭhira).
Pauravanandana^1 = Bharata: I, 3713.
Pauravanandana^2 = Śāntanu: I, 3935.
Pauravanandana^3 = Saṃvaraṇa: I, 6529.
Pauravanandana^4 = Vasu Uparicara: I, 2325 (Vº).
Pauraveśvara (“the king of the Pauravas”). § 284 (Sahadeva): II, 31, 1164 (in the south, vanquished by Sahadeva).
Paurika (“the king of Purikā”), a prince. § 641 (Rājadh.): XII, 111, 4085.
Paurukutsa (“son of Purukutsa”) = Trasadasyu: III, 8606 (Tº).
Paurūravasa, adj. (“belonging to Purūravas”). § 607 (Karṇap.): VIII, 50, 1866 (vṛttaṃ).
*Paurusha, adj. (“belonging to Purusha”). § 524c (Vishṇu): III, 272, 15824 (ºī tanuḥ).--§ 717b (Nārāyaṇīya); XII, 348, 13466 (ºīṃ tanuṃ).
